sources.title: Ministry of Internal Affairs of Armenia, Migration and Citizenship Service, Acquiring an Identification Card
sources.said: After turning 16, RA citizens may voluntarily acquire an identification card, which serves as a document confirming their identity and citizenship and is intended for use within the territory of the Republic of Armenia. The identification card is issued with a validity period of 10 years. ... To acquire an identification card, a fee of 3,000 AMD shall be paid. ... The identification card is issued on the 15th working day following the submission of the application. ... 3,000 + 20,000 AMD – if the card is to be received 1 working day after submission, 3,000 + 10,000 AMD – if the card is to be received on the 3rd working day after submission, 3,000 + 5,000 AMD – if the card is to be received on the 5th working day after submission.
